name: Ecomail
line: Send newsletters, automated marketing, and transactional email from one hosted service.

free.text: Free up to 200 contacts and 200 emails/month

subs.math: 1,000 contacts × 4 campaigns = 4,000 emails a month. The Profi plan's 2,000-contact tier costs USD 35 a month.
5,000 contacts × 4 campaigns = 20,000 emails a month. The Profi plan's 5,000-contact tier costs USD 60 a month.
10,000 contacts × 4 campaigns = 40,000 emails a month. The Profi plan's 10,000-contact tier costs USD 90 a month.
200,000 recipient emails a month. 50,000 subscribers need an individual quote.

appmail.math: 3,000 app emails a month, with 300 existing active contacts. The Marketer+ base plan costs USD 30 a month.
10,000 app emails a month, with 1,000 existing active contacts. The Marketer+ base plan costs USD 53 a month.
50,000 app emails a month, with 5,000 existing active contacts. The Marketer+ base plan costs USD 90 a month.
100,000 app emails a month, with 10,000 existing active contacts. The Marketer+ base plan costs USD 135 a month.
